name: Online-Mind2Web
description: Online-Mind2Web is an online evaluation benchmark consisting of 300 diverse and realistic tasks across 136 websites, designed to assess the capabilities of autonomous web agents in a setting that approximates real user interactions. It includes a novel LLM-as-a-Judge automatic evaluation method to facilitate scalable and reliable assessment.
reputation: A newer web-agent benchmark that extends Mind2Web-style evaluation to online settings and is still emerging in community adoption.
notes: Includes a novel LLM-as-a-Judge evaluation method achieving ~85% agreement with human judgment.
